title: 第21章 女鬼命案第22章 案发现场
content_zh:
夜色如墨，竹窗被风推得轻晃，一道红影贴着墙根飘来，裙裾扫过地面，带起几缕寒气。
赤衣紫唇，女鬼长发遮面，隐约露出的指尖泛着青黑，在月色阴影的笼罩下，只朝着仙塾最中心的居住地而去，那里正是塾内精英学子的集中居住区。
小屋内蒲团静坐，吴燃灯手掐印诀，口鼻间呼吸若隐若无，桌案前摆放着诸多符章。
正气歌居中，呼啸间，正气如风如云，如同阵眼，让吴燃灯如同泡在温泉中，相互交感，气息迅速壮大，化实。
天地人三才章分列四周，如阵法的四梁八柱，搭建风水，引动虚空灵气汇聚而来，又在阵眼中被转化成浩然正气。
符章为本，虚空布阵，藏风纳水。
人坐其中，与阵相合，天人交感。
显然吴燃灯结合四书五经的精髓，诸多道经的神韵，符法初步搭建了修行的框架。
儒家养气、道家风水…符法成章、阵法布局…
极道修士，融诸法为一炉，初见端倪，就显峥嵘。
吴燃灯只感到周围灵气如水，正气汇聚成洪，不需他多做调息吐纳，体内灵气漩涡竟是被推动着转动，肉眼可见的壮大，如同处在浪头的风帆，被水流推在前方被动地飞速前进。
“小郎君，良辰美景，何不出来玩啊？”一阵慵懒笑声，魅惑入耳，似有猫爪在心头挠动，让人心痒痒得难受，热血上涌，气血浮动。
吴燃灯眉头微蹙，脑海中却有金钟大吕之声回荡，“皇路当清夷，含和吐明庭。时穷节乃见，一一垂丹青”，“圣人之静也，非曰静也善，故静也。万物无足以铙心者，故静也”。
大言微义，诸多杂念，一清而空，恢复清明。
那门外女人魅惑，以及急促敲门，都如同虫鸣鸟叫，过耳不闻。
砰砰砰！
人在屋内，偏偏久敲，无人回应。
屋外女人似是急了，陡然一阵爆响，红影穿窗而入。
阴气瞬间弥漫开来，烛火猛地一缩，化作豆大的光晕，屋内一片昏暗。
女鬼化作一团幽影，正要扑向蒲团上端坐的人影，突然身形一僵，呆立原地。

只见屋内四面八方，摆满了符章，充斥着浩然正大之气，刺得她浑身剧痛，冒出阵阵白烟，直逼得她魂体震颤。
“啊——！”
女鬼尖叫着后退，这哪里是什么人间善地，分明是鬼魂阴灵的龙潭虎穴。
嗤…嗤！
长发下的双眼翻出惨白，被那正气灼得剧痛，白烟四起。
她扑来的身影立刻倒退而回，慌不择路，东闯西撞，掀起阴风阵阵。
四周符章字迹愈发大亮，正气、灵气猛的迸发而出，将阴气死死挡在三尺之外。
不过片刻，女鬼便再也受不住，转身化作一道红烟，撞破后窗仓皇逃窜，连带着院中的月光都似被染得凄冷几分。
吴燃灯缓缓睁开眼，目光落于窗外。
符章之上的正气、灵气纷纷收敛，重归平静。
他起身走到案前，指尖抚过“正”字的捺脚，那里的灵气犹带余温。
“原来这符章聚的正气，竟有自发驱邪之效。”
他若有所思，“看来，这符章奥妙，比我想的还要深奥。”
窗外的风渐渐停了，只余下虫鸣低吟，仿佛刚才的惊魂一幕从未发生。
吴燃灯望着后窗破开的窟窿，夜风卷着寒气灌进来，他却只是伸手将符章重新摆好重新坐回灯下。
案上的《太玄》还摊在“固守心神”一页，墨迹在烛火下泛着沉静的光。
“养女鬼，歪门邪道……”他低声自语，指尖在书页上轻轻点了点。
仙籍名额之争，竟已到了不惜动用阴邪手段的地步。
方才那女鬼，怨气中带着刻意驯养的戾气，显然是冲着他来的。
或许与他仙业入门，首席学子，树大招风有关。

想要提前祸害对手吗？使出这么不入流的手段！
content_en:
The night was as dark as ink, and the bamboo windows were slightly swayed by the wind. A red shadow floated against the wall, and the skirt swept across the ground, bringing with it a few wisps of cold air.
The female ghost has red clothes and purple lips, her face is covered by long hair, and her slightly exposed fingertips are green and black. Under the shadow of the moon, she only heads towards the most central residence of the Immortal School, where the elite students in the school are concentrated.
Sitting quietly on a futon in the hut, Wu Randeng made seals with his hands, breathing faintly between his mouth and nose. There were many talismans placed in front of the table.
The song of righteousness is in the middle, and in the whistling, righteousness is like wind and clouds, like the eyes of the formation, making Wu Randeng feel like he is soaking in a hot spring, interacting with each other, and the breath quickly grows and becomes solid.
The Three Talents Chapters of Heaven, Earth, and Man are arranged around, like the four beams and eight pillars of the formation, creating Feng Shui, causing the spiritual energy of the void to gather, and then be transformed into awe-inspiring righteousness in the eyes of the formation.
The talisman is the basis, and the formation is arranged in the void to hide the wind and accept the water.
When people sit in it, they are in harmony with the formation, and heaven and man interact with each other.
Obviously, Wu Randeng combined the essence of the Four Books and Five Classics, the charm of many Taoist scriptures, and the talismans to initially build a framework for practice.
Confucian Qi nourishing, Taoist Feng Shui...talisman formation, formation layout...
The cultivator of the Supreme Dao, who fuses all dharma into one furnace, appears to be outstanding at first sight.
Wu Randeng only felt that the spiritual energy around him was like water, and the righteous energy gathered into a flood. Without the need for him to adjust his breath, the whirlpool of spiritual energy in his body was actually pushed and rotated. It became visible to the naked eye, like a sail on the wave, being pushed forward by the current and moving forward passively.
"Young gentleman, why don't you come out and play with the beautiful scenery?" A burst of lazy laughter was charming, as if a cat's claws were scratching in the heart, making people feel itchy and uncomfortable, and the blood surged up and the energy and blood floated.
Wu Randeng frowned slightly, but the voice of Jinzhong Dalu echoed in his mind, "The imperial road should be clear to the Yi, and the Han and Tu Mingting should be clear. When the time is poor, it is seen, and the paintings are drawn one by one."
Big words and small meanings, many distracting thoughts, are cleared away, and clarity is restored.
The charming woman outside the door and the hasty knocking on the door were like the chirping of insects and birds, which went unheard.
Bang bang bang!
I was in the house, but I kept knocking for a long time, but no one responded.
The woman outside the house seemed to be anxious, there was a sudden explosion, and a red shadow came through the window.
Yin energy spread instantly, the candle flame shrank suddenly, turning into a huge halo, and the room became dark.
The female ghost turned into a shadow and was about to pounce on the figure sitting on the futon when she suddenly froze and stood still.
She saw that the room was filled with talismans from all directions, filled with aura of awe-inspiring righteousness. It stung her whole body with severe pain, and sent out bursts of white smoke, which made her soul tremble.
"Ah——!"
The female ghost screamed and retreated. This was not a good place in the world. It was clearly a dragon's den and a tiger's den of ghosts and ghosts.
Tsk...tsk!
The eyes under the long hair turned pale, burning with severe pain from the righteousness, and white smoke was everywhere.
The figure she rushed towards immediately retreated back, panicking and rushing around, causing gusts of sinister wind.
The writing on the surrounding talismans became brighter and brighter, and righteousness and spiritual energy burst out fiercely, blocking the Yin energy three feet away.
However, after a moment, the female ghost couldn't stand it any longer. She turned around and turned into a streak of red smoke, smashing through the back window and fleeing hastily. Even the moonlight in the courtyard seemed to be dyed a bit colder.
Wu Randeng slowly opened his eyes and looked outside the window.
The righteousness and spiritual energy on the talisman converged and returned to calm.
He stood up and walked to the case. His fingertips touched the foot of the word "正", and the aura there was still warm.
"It turns out that the righteousness gathered in this talisman has the effect of spontaneously exorcising evil spirits."
He thought thoughtfully, "It seems that the mystery of this talisman is more profound than I thought."
The wind outside the window gradually stopped, leaving only the chirping of insects, as if the frightening scene just now had never happened.
Wu Randeng looked at the hole in the back window. The night wind blew in the cold air, but he just stretched out his hand to rearrange the talisman and sat back under the lamp.
The copy of "Tai Xuan" on the desk was still open on the page "Stick to the Mind", and the ink stains were glowing under the candlelight.Silent light.
"The adopted daughter is evil and evil..." He whispered to himself, tapping his fingertips lightly on the page.
The fight for the number of immortals has reached the point where they do not hesitate to use evil means.
The female ghost just now had a deliberately domesticated hostility in her resentment, and she was obviously aiming at him.
Perhaps it has something to do with his introduction to the immortal industry, being the chief student, and having a big tree that attracts wind.
Want to harm your opponent in advance? Using such unsavory methods!
